job_to_be_done: Append a paragraph block to an existing Notion page so the owner can store notes, summaries, or action items in Notion.
summary_for_model: Appends one paragraph block to a Notion page using the Notion API. Requires `page_id` and `content`. Uses `NOTION_API_KEY` from the environment. Dry-run validates only and does not call Notion.
approval_summary_template: Append a paragraph to a Notion page after approval.
side_effect_summary: Appends one paragraph block to a Notion page via the Notion API.

summary.description: Preview of the action that would be executed after approval.

content_preview.description: First characters of the paragraph that would be appended.

trigger_conditions: The owner wants to add a short note, summary, or log line to a Notion page.
The agent has text content and the owner provides a Notion page_id to append to.
The agent is writing results back to a Notion workspace for record-keeping.
The owner asks to append a paragraph to a specific Notion page.
do_not_use_when: The owner has not granted Notion access via an integration token.
The owner needs rich layout (tables, toggles, headings) beyond a single paragraph block.
The content contains secrets (API keys, passwords) that should not be stored in Notion.

page_id.description: Notion page/block id to append children to (32 hex chars, with or without dashes).

summary.description: One-line summary of what was appended (or would be appended in dry_run).

appended_block_ids.description: IDs of newly appended blocks when available.

fetched_at.description: ISO timestamp when the action was executed (or validated in dry_run).

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds (0 for this action adapter).

usage_hints: The owner must create a Notion integration and share the target page with that integration.
Set `NOTION_API_KEY` in the runtime environment (do not include it in prompts or files).
Use the page_id from the Notion URL or API; accept both dashed and undashed forms.
Keep content short; if you have multiple paragraphs, call the tool multiple times.
result_hints: Confirm the append succeeded and echo the target page_id back to the owner.
If appended_block_ids are returned, include them for traceability.
If the Notion API returns warnings, mention them in the summary.
error_hints: If `NOTION_API_KEY` is missing, return a clear configuration error and explain how to set it.
If page_id is malformed, ask the owner to provide a valid Notion page/block id.
If Notion returns 429, tell the owner to retry after the suggested cooldown.
If Notion returns 401/403, indicate the token may be invalid or lacks access to the page.
